cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in this new flat, we'll do five breaths together. Count them for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. One more round while I look at the kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Stay until it boils; I'll take it from there. One cup this time.

reason: Remove status padding and accept B practical kettle solution as the endpoint for presence, keeping A planned first solo action in the spoken ending.
